subject: business-studies

moments.title: Deming lectures in Japan
moments.body: Deming's lectures on statistical quality control help shape postwar Japanese manufacturing.
moments.takeaway: Statistical methods underpinned Japan's quality revolution.

moments.title: Out of the Crisis
moments.body: Deming's book sets out his 14 points for management, contrasting Japanese and US practice.
moments.takeaway: Quality is built in by management, not inspected in.

moments.title: Six Sigma at Motorola
moments.body: Motorola develops Six Sigma to achieve 3.4 defects per million opportunities, building on Deming's statistical foundations.
moments.takeaway: Quality methods institutionalised as named programs.

now.title: Quality in modern operations
now.body: Lean Six Sigma combines TPS waste-elimination and Six Sigma variation-reduction in healthcare, services and software.
now.open_questions: How do agile and lean traditions interact in modern software operations?

reflection: Deming was unknown in the US for decades while shaping Japanese industry.
